Its note1 marker11674 owns the later historical inscription narrative11719–11759, emitted inside the next raw frame; that complete substantive note is retained here. XVI. at LF11493–11493; the source closing at LF11676–11679 reads: Datum in Arce Gandulphi sub annulo pisca- toris die decima octava augusti millesimo octin- gentesimo quadragesimo, pontificatus Nostri anno decimo..
